title: Project Serpo exchange program

tellings.quote: So the Serpo thing was planet Serpo sent a bunch of aliens here and we sent a bunch of humans to their star system in an exchange in the 1970s sometime.

plain: Project Serpo is the claim, spread through a so-called leak, that aliens from a planet called Serpo sent some of their own to Earth while the United States sent a group of humans to their star system, in an exchange sometime in the 1970s. The researcher Greg Bishop sums it up on the show and ties it to a man named Rick Doty. If true, it would mean the government had a secret exchange program with another world.
